title: Session autostart: cold boot brings up only helyx, a restart restores what was live

AC1.note: tests/unit/restore-plan.test.ts: 'a new boot id starts the autostart set, whatever the snapshot holds' — full snapshot + changed boot id returns [helyx]

AC2.note: tests/unit/restore-plan.test.ts: snapshot restored exactly; 'a snapshot smaller than the autostart set still wins' covers the subset case

AC3.note: tests/unit/restore-plan.test.ts: empty / missing / unmatched snapshot each fall back to the autostart set; nothing-flagged falls back to helyx

AC4.note: cli.ts tmuxStop calls snapshotLiveWindows() (reads tmux list-windows) before kill-session; codec covered by the snapshot tests

AC5.note: tests/unit/migrations-apply.test.ts: host_state + session_state_events in the table list, projects.autostart present and default false, seed not overwritten on replay, 'running again applies nothing'

AC6.note: tests/unit/session-state-events.test.ts: one row per applied transition with from_status, zero rows for a rejected transition, history appends

AC7.note: scripts/admin-daemon.ts proj_start dead-server branch runs up --only <name>; verified by reading — the branch needs a host with no tmux server

AC8.note: typecheck clean; dupes exit 0; bun test 2566 pass / 2 fail (tts E1, pre-existing, utils/tts.ts imports no changed module); CI on PR 117 green after a flaky rerun
